issue.title: Launch the identity helper through junction or symlink checkout paths
issue.body:
<!-- graphgoblin-dispatch:2026-11-13 -->
**Current dispatch (2026-11-13):** Released for the fourth lane, after runtime recovery; coordinate with separate owner-held PR #460 without changing its hold. The [new scoped authorization](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/279#issuecomment-6872558885) supersedes older implementation holds below for this bounded work only. Preserve independent review, QA, exact-head audit and conditional reproduction. This bounded issue may close after its engineering gates and merge; owner acceptance and closure on #276/#325 remain separate. Historical plan and evidence follow.
<!-- /graphgoblin-dispatch:2026-11-13 -->

Follow-up from #433 and [the independent review](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/433#pullrequestreview-5815159382) of `b71c70605a7887557efda15ecaddf11988dcfdb0`.

Priority: P2. The helper's direct-execution check compares a resolved argv path with Node's realpathed module URL. A checkout reached through a directory junction/symlink can print no identity and cause an invalid-runtime/configuration refusal. The verified owner checkout uses a plain directory, so this does not block its rollout.

Acceptance:
- Canonicalize entrypoint detection or use explicit dispatch.
- Invocation through real and aliased checkout paths prints exactly one valid identity.
- Native cold/warm launch works through both paths, preserving wrong-store/configuration refusals.

Dedup: related #276. #344 is plugin-builder output ownership, a different component/root cause. No matching open or recently closed issue was found.

Original disposition: DEFER-ISSUE, non-blocking for #433. The owner subsequently dispatched this bounded work on 2026-11-13; it is now eligible in the fourth lane after runtime recovery. Launcher delivery order is #435, #436, #438, then #456. This issue does not complete owner acceptance on #276/#325.

Delivery: isolated implementation and cross-family review at xhigh after dispatch; independent QA must verify the listed touched systems. No owner service/store or secrets should be used for regression tests.

## Delivery checkpoint — 2026-11-16

PR #492 publishes candidate `6f383da798872aa0e6bd1e0de1fdcd4e702de9ae` over `9fa8b2474c7290adb800c5e26be73511095cae25`. GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh implemented the physical-entry detection correction; a separate GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh QA agent verified the local native junction matrix and exact cleanup. Focused API tests (13/13), built-helper regression (2/2), types/lint/format passed. The final helper regression and hosted Windows test-only baseline reproduced the old defect; hosted baseline created both real Junction and SymbolicLink. [Baseline evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/6f383da798872aa0e6bd1e0de1fdcd4e702de9ae/docs/qa/2026-11-16-launcher-identity-baseline/README.md) · [Implementation](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/6f383da798872aa0e6bd1e0de1fdcd4e702de9ae/docs/qa/2026-11-16-launcher-identity-implementation/README.md) · [Candidate and hosted baseline](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/6f383da798872aa0e6bd1e0de1fdcd4e702de9ae/docs/qa/2026-11-16-launcher-identity-candidate/README.md).

[Current-head CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43790735875) passed all four jobs on attempt 1, without retry. All 13 line/branch coverage floors passed with 9,619 tests / 41 skips. Browser passed 481 with one declared live-provider skip and zero retries; optional strict routing bounds were off. Windows passed 17/17, independently verified on actual Junction and SymbolicLink: four cold starts, eight warm reuses, eight mismatch refusals and four managed drains. No Windows native artifact was uploaded; full structured records are in the job log. All four image templates loaded. The configured audit threshold passed with 8 low / 13 moderate advisories. [Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh scan 1](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/492#issuecomment-6906188155) returned READY with no introduced blocker; root dispositions are recorded and #493–#496 are parked follow-ups. [Fresh Astra max final audit](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/492#issuecomment-6906437749) returned SIGN-OFF. Two of three formal scans are complete. PR #492 merged as `be633141be5a0cd2b4f960a46761fabbf2cb82c7`; root verified ordered parents `9fa8b2474c7290adb800c5e26be73511095cae25` and `6f383da798872aa0e6bd1e0de1fdcd4e702de9ae`, and tree `decd1ca26c9bd63d942e939e65e2b2604d7f2652` exactly matches the tested merge. This bounded issue is engineering-complete. Owner acceptance for #276/#325, the separate PR #460 hold, installation and remaining #436/#438/#456 work are separate and unchanged.
